description: Put an existing item on a trail. Attach an existing queue item to the trail, recorded with source `attached`, optionally into a milestone (`milestoneId`). An item is on at most one trail; one already on another trail is refused with `409`. To file a *new* item on a trail, use `ops bug --trail` or `ops feature…

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

item.description: The queue item to put on the trail (number or id). An item is on at most one trail.

milestoneId.description: The milestone to put the item in (`TrailMilestone.id`). Omitted, the item is in no milestone.

name: trails_items_add
